sources.title: NYSC chief warns corps members over campaigns and AI misinformation
sources.snippet: On 2026-08-19, NYSC Director-General Brig. Gen. Olakunle Nafiu warned corps members at the NYSC Permanent Orientation Camp in Katsina against partisan political campaigns and spreading AI-generated misinformation. He said members using NYSC identities or social-media accounts to promote parties or candidates could face disciplinary measures, according to Arise TV.
